meta.origin: Density, spacing and control heights extracted from axlchris/tagstudio@112877f (src/styles/main.css). Palette, type weights, radii and elevation designed 2026-09-22 as 'direction D': skeleton from Linear (4px base, radius 6/12, weight 400/500, hairlines), temperature and button logic from Factory (warm near-black, light primary button, orange as detail), numerals rule from Tinybird (mono for everything numeric). This file is the source of truth; the claude.ai Marker artifact is a view of it.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The canvas. Warm near-black, not grey; the depth everything else is measured against. Also the background of inputs.

tokens.name: bg2
tokens.usage: First lift: cards, table headers, toolbars, side panels. Barely distinct from bg, on purpose.

tokens.name: bg3
tokens.usage: Second lift: hover on bg2 surfaces, active segment, selected row. Three layers is all there is; needing a fourth means the structure is wrong.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The hairline. Table rows, panel edges, resting input border, inset card edge. Always 1px. Never carries meaning.

tokens.name: border2
tokens.usage: Stronger edge where an element must lift off the surface: scrollbar thumb, controls floating over content. 1.7:1 against bg; still not a signal.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text. Not pure white in dark: #eee sits calmly on warm black where #fff glares. 16.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, metadata, artist names, inactive tabs. 9.3:1 dark / 6.6:1 light. Carries most of the hierarchy together with weight.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder, disabled text, eyebrow labels in cards. 5.2:1 dark (AA), 3.5:1 light; in light only for text that repeats something the user sees elsewhere.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view. Light in dark theme, dark in light; no chroma. It is the only filled button on screen, which is why it exists.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text on primary. 16.6:1 / 17.7:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on primary. One step towards the extreme.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The project's chroma, used as a DETAIL, never a surface: the mark, the marker stripe on a row, an icon. Never button fill, never focus border, never selected row. As text only in dark (5.8:1); 3.2:1 in light. This is the token a project rebinds: Intellitrader sets a cool colour here and keeps orange for Live.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: Hover on the little that uses accent, and the readable variant in light (4.3:1: large figures and icons, not body text).

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Tint of accent for an active chip or a highlighted field. Text on it is text, not accent.

tokens.name: sel-bg
tokens.usage: Selected row. A neutral lift, deliberately: selection is not a warning. Alias of bg3 so the two can never drift apart.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on table rows. One step below selected, so selected always wins.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px outline with 1px offset, the text colour at 30%. Visible on every surface in both themes without chroma. Did not exist in the source.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Positive status: connected, running, profit. Desaturated on purpose so it can sit in twenty rows without shouting. 10.4:1 dark / 6.1:1 light. Always with a word or a sign, never alone.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Waiting, paused, warning. 9.7:1 dark / 6.1:1 light. Readable as text in both themes.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error, loss, destructive actions. 5.5:1 dark / 5.9:1 light. Reserved for this, and in Intellitrader for Live together with accent.

tokens.name: green-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a green status chip. green on it: 7.8:1 dark / 5.0:1 light.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind an amber status chip. amber on it: 7.4:1 / 4.9:1.

tokens.name: red-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a red status chip, and the background of an error line in a card. red on it: 4.6:1 / 4.8:1.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and covers. 500, not 600: size does the work, weight stays low.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title inside a card. Same size as body; weight and position say it is a title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base size on html, body and every control. Running text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, help text, list content. The most common size in the app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers and field labels, in text2. Weight 500 is the ceiling for the whole system.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button text at every size. No tracking.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every number in a column: amounts, pips, BPM, year, file size. Mono is half a pixel wider than Inter, hence 11.5 beside 12. Signs are written out: +82.40, −31.10.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Key figures in cards: unrealised P/L, countdown, balance. Read at a distance.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Status chips, eyebrow labels, environment strip; mono, uppercase. 10px is the floor.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata under a card title: EUR_USD · BarTrender Pro · H4. Mono because these are identifiers, not prose.

spacing.note: From the TagStudio code, unchanged. 4px base. The references use an 8px base and 24px card padding; those are landing pages, this is an app.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Hairline clearance, e.g. between dot and word in a chip.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between elements inside one control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group, between fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap. Start here.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding in buttons and cells; between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards and panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups in a form; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections. The largest gap in use.

radius.note: Three levels instead of one: control, card, badge. This is what gives surfaces a hierarchy.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, thumbnails, scrollbar.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, segmented control. The value TagStudio already had.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, popovers, the app frame. A 6px card looks like a large button.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, slider thumbs.

control.note: From the TagStudio code. Everything on one row has the same height.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons inside cards and compact toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height: input, select, toolbar buttons, segmented control.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Action buttons in modals and forms.

shadow.note: Elevation is hairlines and layers of darkness. Shadow exists only on what actually floats above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The card edge, inset so it adds no width. Same colour as border. This is all the elevation a card gets.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, toasts: what sits above the page. Nothing else.
